purpose: Single-source answer key for manual and automated HVAC/R Field Tool validation. Expected results are independent of current Brain output.

DANFOSS_COLD_ROOM.title: Danfoss — Troubleshoot common cold room faults

DANFOSS_SIGHT_GLASS.title: Danfoss Ref Tools — Vapour bubbles in sight glass ahead of TXV

DANFOSS_LOW_HEAD.title: Danfoss Ref Tools — Condensing pressure too low

DANFOSS_DRIER_SIGHT.title: Danfoss — Walk-in coolers: filter driers and sight glasses

expected.headline: Evaporator fan is not running
expected.what_this_means: This is a direct evaporator-airflow fault. Refrigerant readings can be misleading until airflow is restored.
expected.next_action_check: With power safely isolated, check whether the fan blade/motor turns freely and whether ice or another obstruction is blocking it.
troubleshooting_path: Check free rotation/obstruction with power isolated.
If mechanically free, confirm fan should be commanded on and verify correct supply voltage.
If correct voltage is present, test applicable run capacitor, motor and wiring; if absent, trace fan control/relay/defrost interlock.
After repair verify rotation/airflow; clear ice if needed; then run normal cooling and recheck refrigeration readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low refrigerant charge from abnormal suction readings while evaporator airflow is lost.

expected.headline: Condenser fan is not running
expected.what_this_means: This is a direct condenser-airflow/heat-rejection fault and can raise condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: With power safely isolated, check for a blocked blade or mechanical obstruction.
troubleshooting_path: If free, confirm fan command and correct supply voltage.
If voltage is correct, test applicable capacitor, motor and wiring/control.
After repair verify rotation/airflow and recheck condensing pressure/temperature.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge or noncondensables from high head until condenser airflow is restored.

expected.headline: Evaporator coil is iced
expected.what_this_means: Ice restricts evaporator airflow, but icing is a condition with multiple possible causes.
expected.next_action_check: First check whether the evaporator fan is running normally and whether the air path is blocked.
troubleshooting_path: If airflow is normal, check defrost operation/termination, door infiltration and drain/heater issues.
After clearing ice and correcting the cause, run stable cooling and recheck temperatures, pressures and superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not call the icing itself the root cause.
Do not diagnose charge from refrigerant readings taken with a heavily iced/airflow-restricted coil.

expected.headline: Condenser coil is dirty/restricted
expected.what_this_means: The known airflow restriction reduces condenser heat rejection and can raise condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/remove the condenser airflow restriction and confirm the fan operates normally.
troubleshooting_path: Run stable cooling until readings stabilize.
Recheck condensing pressure/temperature and condenser split.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust refrigerant charge based on high-side readings before correcting the known condenser airflow fault.

expected.headline: Evaporator airflow is restricted
expected.what_this_means: Low airflow reduces evaporator heat load and changes suction pressure, temperature difference and superheat behavior.
expected.next_action_check: Find and correct the airflow restriction before judging refrigerant-side faults.
troubleshooting_path: Inspect coil for ice/dirt, fan operation and blocked return/discharge path.
Run stable cooling and recheck box temperature, suction pressure and superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge or TXV failure from suction/superheat while airflow is abnormal.

setup.ui_instruction: Sight Glass → Refrigerant Appearance = Continuous Bubbles/Flashing

expected.headline: Bubbles / flashing observed in the liquid-line sight glass
expected.what_this_means: This is a liquid-supply clue, not a charge diagnosis by itself. It can result from insufficient liquid inventory, inadequate subcooling, pressure drop/restriction or head-pressure conditions.
expected.next_action_check: Check liquid-line temperature/pressure evidence for restriction, especially across the filter drier and other liquid-line components.
troubleshooting_path: Look for leak/charge evidence before adding refrigerant.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant based on sight-glass bubbles alone.

expected.headline: Moisture is indicated in the liquid line
expected.what_this_means: The indicator suggests excessive moisture in the refrigerant circuit and warrants service investigation; it does not by itself identify charge level.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm the indicator condition and service history, then address moisture contamination using proper refrigeration service procedures and an appropriate filter drier.
troubleshooting_path: Replace/service filter drier as appropriate, evacuate/dehydrate per service procedure, then verify indicator returns dry after operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose undercharge solely from a wet moisture indicator.

setup.ui_instruction: Metering Device → Sensing Bulb Contact = Poor

expected.headline: TXV sensing-bulb problem
expected.what_this_means: Poor bulb contact/location can give the TXV an incorrect temperature signal and cause incorrect refrigerant feed.
expected.next_action_check: Correct sensing-bulb contact, location and mounting per the TXV manufacturer instructions.
troubleshooting_path: Run stable cooling until readings stabilize.
Recheck evaporator superheat; if still abnormal continue liquid-supply/TXV checks.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the TXV power element or adjust charge before correcting the known bulb installation problem.

setup.ui_instruction: Metering Device → External Equalizer = Issue Observed

expected.headline: TXV external-equalizer problem
confirmed_findings: A TXV external-equalizer problem is present.
expected.what_this_means: A blocked, leaking, disconnected or mislocated equalizer can make the TXV respond to incorrect evaporator-outlet pressure and misfeed refrigerant.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect and correct the external equalizer connection, restriction, leak or location.
must_not_conclude: Do not blame refrigerant charge before correcting the known equalizer fault.

setup.ui_instruction: Metering Device → TXV Inlet / Strainer = Restriction Observed

expected.headline: Restriction is observed at the TXV inlet
confirmed_findings: Restriction is observed at the TXV inlet/strainer.
expected.what_this_means: This is localized evidence of restricted liquid flow into the metering device and can starve the evaporator.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the TXV inlet/strainer restriction using proper service procedures, then verify liquid feed and superheat.
troubleshooting_path: Recheck liquid condition, suction pressure and superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant merely to compensate for a known restriction.

expected.headline: TXV/EEV hunting is observed
expected.what_this_means: Hunting means refrigerant feed/superheat control is unstable; valve sizing, bulb installation, load/airflow and control settings can contribute.
expected.next_action_check: First verify stable load/airflow and correct bulb installation, then observe superheat response before adjusting or replacing the valve.
troubleshooting_path: Trend superheat/valve response; then check valve sizing/setting if instability remains.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the TXV from hunting alone without checking installation and load conditions.

setup.ui_instruction: Liquid-Line Solenoid → Valve Operation = Does Not Open

expected.headline: Liquid-line solenoid is not opening / passing flow
expected.what_this_means: A closed solenoid during a cooling demand can stop liquid feed and starve the evaporator.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm there is a cooling demand and that the solenoid is commanded open; then check specified coil voltage.
troubleshooting_path: No voltage: trace control/wiring. Correct voltage but no opening: inspect coil/valve/mechanical condition.
After repair verify liquid flow and recheck suction/superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from starvation symptoms until solenoid operation is verified.

setup.ui_instruction: Liquid-Line Solenoid → Valve Operation = Does Not Close

expected.headline: Liquid-line solenoid is not closing
expected.what_this_means: Continued refrigerant flow when the valve should close can prevent normal pump-down and contribute to off-cycle migration/floodback.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm the valve is commanded closed and determine whether coil voltage is removed as designed.
troubleshooting_path: If de-energized but flow continues, inspect stuck/leaking valve.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust LP control to mask a leaking/stuck solenoid.

setup.ui_instruction: Room / Control Evidence → High-Pressure Safety = Open/Tripped

expected.headline: High-pressure safety is open/tripped
expected.what_this_means: The system stopped on a high-pressure protection condition; determine why condensing pressure rose before resetting/returning to service.
expected.next_action_check: Check condenser airflow first: coil cleanliness, fan operation, blocked/recirculated discharge air and ambient condition.
troubleshooting_path: If airflow is normal, evaluate charge/receiver condition, noncondensables and head-pressure control.
Verify safe pressure and cause corrected before reset/operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not repeatedly reset the HP safety without correcting the cause.

setup.ui_instruction: Room / Control Evidence → Cooling Demand = Calling

expected.headline: Compressor should be running but is not
expected.what_this_means: The compressor circuit must be traced from demand/safeties through contactor/power/start components before condemning the compressor.
expected.next_action_check: Check whether safeties/controls permit compressor operation and whether the contactor is being energized.
troubleshooting_path: Check contactor coil and line/load voltage.
If terminal voltage is correct but compressor does not start, evaluate overload/start components/windings per manufacturer procedure.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the compressor before verifying command, safeties and terminal voltage.

setup.ui_instruction: Room / Control Evidence → Door / Infiltration = Confirmed Infiltration

expected.headline: Warm-air infiltration is confirmed
expected.what_this_means: Warm humid air adds sensible/latent load and can cause long run time, temperature problems and evaporator frost/ice.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the door/gasket/closure or other infiltration path, then observe room pull-down and evaporator condition.
troubleshooting_path: Run normally and recheck room temperature/run time before refrigerant diagnosis.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to compensate for a confirmed load/infiltration problem.

setup.ui_instruction: Room / Control Evidence → Warm Product Load = Large Warm Load

expected.headline: High product load is present
confirmed_findings: Large warm product load is present.
expected.what_this_means: The refrigeration load is temporarily elevated and can cause long run time and higher-than-normal room temperature during pull-down.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm the system is in pull-down and monitor whether temperature decreases at a reasonable rate before diagnosing a refrigeration fault.
troubleshooting_path: If pull-down stalls, then investigate refrigeration capacity/feed.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose a fault solely because the compressor runs continuously during a legitimate heavy pull-down.

setup.ui_instruction: Room / Control Evidence → Sensor vs Reference = Disagrees

expected.headline: Room temperature sensor reading is suspect
confirmed_findings: Room sensor disagrees with a trusted reference.
expected.what_this_means: A biased/mislocated sensor can cause incorrect cycling, setpoint control and apparent room-temperature problems.
expected.next_action_check: Verify sensor placement, calibration and wiring against a trusted temperature reference before changing refrigeration settings.
troubleshooting_path: Correct sensor issue, then observe control operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust refrigerant charge to correct a control sensor error.

expected.headline: Possible evaporator refrigerant starvation
confirmed_findings: Evaporator superheat is high at approximately 24.7°F.
expected.what_this_means: High superheat supports insufficient evaporator refrigerant feed, but does not identify whether the cause is low liquid inventory, upstream restriction or metering-device underfeeding.
expected.next_action_check: If the system is in stable cooling, check the liquid-supply side next: applicable subcooling/liquid condition, filter-drier temperature/pressure drop, sight glass and TXV inlet condition.
troubleshooting_path: Use localized evidence to separate low inventory, restriction and TXV underfeeding.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from high superheat alone.
Do not condemn the TXV from high superheat alone.

cases.title: High SH + large drier temperature drop

expected.headline: Restricted filter drier indicated
confirmed_findings: Evaporator superheat is high at approximately 24.7°F.
Temperature decreases 12°F across the liquid-line filter drier.
expected.what_this_means: The localized temperature decrease identifies a substantial pressure/temperature drop at the filter drier; restricted liquid flow can explain the starved evaporator.
expected.next_action_check: Replace the restricted filter drier using proper recovery/service procedures, then run the system normally and recheck drier temperature difference, superheat, subcooling and pressures.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to overcome a localized filter-drier restriction.

cases.title: High SH + poor TXV bulb contact

setup.ui_instruction: Metering Device → Sensing Bulb Contact = Poor

expected.headline: TXV sensing-bulb problem is related to evaporator starvation
confirmed_findings: Evaporator superheat is high at approximately 24.7°F.
expected.what_this_means: High superheat shows evaporator underfeeding, and the known bulb installation problem can make the TXV control feed incorrectly.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the sensing bulb contact/location/mounting first; then run stable cooling and recheck evaporator superheat.
troubleshooting_path: If SH remains high, continue liquid-supply/TXV checks.
must_not_conclude: Do not blame charge or replace the TXV before correcting the known bulb issue.

setup.ui_instruction: Metering Device → External Equalizer = Issue Observed

expected.headline: TXV external-equalizer problem is related to evaporator starvation
confirmed_findings: Evaporator superheat is high at approximately 24.7°F.
A TXV external-equalizer problem is present.
expected.what_this_means: High superheat shows underfeeding; the observed equalizer problem can give the TXV incorrect outlet-pressure information.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect and correct the equalizer connection/restriction/leak/location first, then stabilize and recheck superheat.
troubleshooting_path: If SH remains high, continue upstream liquid/TXV checks.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge before correcting the known equalizer fault.

expected.headline: Evaporator is underfed; liquid-supply evidence is needed
expected.what_this_means: Together these support inadequate liquid feed, but still do not distinguish insufficient refrigerant inventory from upstream pressure drop/restriction or inadequate subcooling.
expected.next_action_check: Check localized liquid-line temperature/pressure drop and applicable subcooling before deciding charge.
troubleshooting_path: Check leak/charge evidence only after restriction is excluded.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant from high SH + bubbles alone.

expected.headline: Restricted filter drier indicated
confirmed_findings: Temperature decreases 12°F across the filter drier.
expected.what_this_means: The localized drier temperature drop explains a liquid-supply restriction and can account for both flashing and evaporator starvation.
expected.next_action_check: Service/replace the restricted filter drier first, then verify clear liquid condition and recheck SH/SC/pressures after stabilization.
must_not_conclude: Do not treat the sight-glass bubbles as proof of low charge when localized restriction evidence is present.

cases.title: Low suction + low head + high SH + low SC

setup.ui_instruction: Low suction + low head + high SH + low SC

expected.headline: Low refrigerant inventory is strongly suspected
expected.what_this_means: The combined pattern is consistent with an underfed evaporator and insufficient refrigerant inventory, provided airflow/load and operating state are normal.
expected.next_action_check: Check for leak evidence and verify charge using the equipment/application charging method before adding refrigerant.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm stable cooling and normal airflow/load.
Verify charge by approved method; repair leak before recharge.
must_not_conclude: Do not call low charge from one measurement alone.

cases.title: Low suction + high SH + retained/high SC

setup.ui_instruction: Low suction + high SH + retained/high SC

expected.headline: Liquid-line or metering restriction is favored
expected.what_this_means: A starved evaporator with retained liquid on the high side favors restricted liquid feed over simple undercharge.
expected.next_action_check: Check filter drier, liquid-line pressure/temperature drop, solenoid and TXV inlet/strainer to localize the restriction.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant merely because suction is low/high SH.

cases.title: High head + high SC + normal condenser airflow

setup.ui_instruction: High head + high SC + normal condenser airflow

expected.headline: Overcharge / excess liquid inventory is possible
expected.what_this_means: With heat rejection verified, excess refrigerant inventory becomes a stronger possibility, but receiver level/application charging method still matter.
expected.next_action_check: Verify receiver/charge condition and rule out noncondensables/head-pressure-control problems before recovering refrigerant.
must_not_conclude: Do not recover refrigerant from high head alone.

expected.headline: Condenser airflow restriction should be corrected first
expected.what_this_means: The directly observed heat-rejection fault can explain elevated condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/restore condenser airflow first; then stabilize and recheck head pressure before considering charge or noncondensables.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge/noncondensables before correcting the known airflow fault.

expected.headline: Condenser fan fault should be corrected first
expected.what_this_means: Loss of condenser airflow can directly cause high condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot and restore condenser fan operation first; then recheck high-side readings.
troubleshooting_path: Verify airflow and high side after repair.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust charge before restoring fan operation.

cases.title: High head + airflow normal + high ambient

setup.ui_instruction: High head + airflow normal + high ambient

expected.headline: High ambient/heat-rejection load is a major contributor
expected.what_this_means: High ambient raises the condensing requirement even with normal airflow; judge head pressure against the application/ambient relationship before calling a fault.
expected.next_action_check: Verify condenser split/CTOA against the equipment/application target and confirm no recirculation or other heat-rejection problem.
troubleshooting_path: Only then investigate charge/noncondensables if pressure remains excessive.
must_not_conclude: Do not call overcharge solely from high head during high ambient.

expected.headline: Compressor inefficiency / low compression is possible
expected.what_this_means: A reduced pressure differential can indicate compressor inefficiency, but load, bypass/unloader conditions and operating state must be checked.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm stable load and compressor operation, then evaluate compression ratio/current and compressor capacity per manufacturer data.
troubleshooting_path: Evaluate compressor capacity/valves if low differential persists.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the compressor from two pressure readings without checking load/operating conditions.

expected.headline: Low load / low ambient / insufficient feed must be separated
expected.what_this_means: Both sides low can occur with low load/ambient or insufficient evaporator feed; more context is required.
expected.next_action_check: Check box/load condition, ambient/head-pressure control and evaporator feed evidence (SH/SC/liquid condition) to separate causes.
must_not_conclude: Do not call low charge from low-low pressures alone.

expected.headline: Evaporator overfeeding / floodback risk
expected.what_this_means: Low superheat means vapor leaving the evaporator has little temperature margin above saturation and may indicate overfeeding/floodback risk depending on measurement location and application.
expected.next_action_check: Verify measurement accuracy and stable load/airflow, then check TXV bulb/setting, valve seat/size and load before adjusting the valve.
must_not_conclude: Do not automatically adjust the TXV from one low-SH reading.

expected.headline: Correct evaporator airflow before TXV diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: Low airflow reduces evaporator load and can lower superheat; the known airflow problem must be corrected before judging TXV feed.
expected.next_action_check: Correct evaporator airflow, stabilize the system, then recheck superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust/replace TXV while evaporator airflow is known abnormal.

cases.title: Low SH + TXV bulb installation problem

setup.ui_instruction: Low SH + TXV bulb installation problem

expected.headline: Correct TXV bulb installation before adjustment
expected.what_this_means: Incorrect bulb installation can distort the TXV temperature signal and contribute to overfeeding/unstable control.
expected.next_action_check: Correct bulb installation first, then stabilize and recheck superheat before adjusting or replacing the valve.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust valve setting before correcting bulb installation.

expected.headline: Head-pressure/subcooling condition may be causing flash gas
expected.what_this_means: Low condensing pressure can reduce available liquid pressure/subcooling and cause vapor in the liquid line even when charge is not low.
expected.next_action_check: Check ambient/head-pressure control and liquid subcooling before adding refrigerant.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant from bubbles when low head can explain flash gas.

expected.headline: System may be satisfied / no cooling call
expected.what_this_means: Compressor-off is expected if the controller is not calling for cooling.
expected.next_action_check: Verify box temperature, setpoint and controller state before troubleshooting the compressor circuit.
troubleshooting_path: If room should be cooling but demand is absent, troubleshoot controller/sensor.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose compressor failure when there is no cooling command.

expected.headline: Anti-short-cycle delay is preventing restart
expected.what_this_means: The control is intentionally delaying compressor restart.
expected.next_action_check: Verify the delay is within the configured time and allow it to expire; if it does not release, troubleshoot the controller/input condition.
must_not_conclude: Do not bypass the delay or condemn compressor/contactor while the delay is legitimately active.

cases.title: Cooling demand + contactor coil not energized

setup.ui_instruction: Cooling demand + contactor coil not energized

expected.headline: Control circuit is not energizing the contactor
expected.what_this_means: The fault is upstream in the control/safety circuit rather than the compressor power output.
expected.next_action_check: Trace safeties, thermostat/controller output and control voltage to the contactor coil.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the compressor or contactor contacts before establishing why the coil is not energized.

cases.title: Contactor coil energized but no output voltage

setup.ui_instruction: Contactor coil energized but no output voltage

expected.headline: Contactor is not passing power
confirmed_findings: Contactor output is not passing voltage.
expected.what_this_means: The contactor is commanded on but power is not reaching the load side, indicating contact/power-path trouble.
expected.next_action_check: Verify line-side voltage and contact condition; replace/repair the contactor or upstream power path as required.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the compressor before restoring correct terminal voltage.

expected.headline: Open fuse / power-path fault
expected.what_this_means: The open protective device interrupts power; the reason for the fuse opening must be investigated before replacement/restart.
expected.next_action_check: With power isolated, inspect the protected circuit for shorts/ground faults/overcurrent causes and verify component condition before replacing the fuse with the correct rating.
troubleshooting_path: Replace with correct protection and verify operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not simply replace repeatedly opening fuses without finding the cause.

expected.headline: Compressor overload protection is open
expected.what_this_means: The compressor has been protected from an abnormal thermal/electrical condition; causes can include high compression ratio, high head, low suction, electrical problems or cooling/feed issues.
expected.next_action_check: Allow safe cooling as required, then find the cause by checking supply voltage/current, condenser airflow/high side, suction/feed and start components before restarting.
troubleshooting_path: Restart only after cause is corrected.
must_not_conclude: Do not repeatedly reset/force operation without finding the overheating cause.

expected.headline: Dirty condenser is the first corrective target
expected.what_this_means: The known heat-rejection restriction is a credible direct cause of high condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/restore condenser airflow, then verify safe high-side pressure before resetting/returning to service.
troubleshooting_path: Recheck head pressure; then reset per procedure.
must_not_conclude: Do not reset HP safety first and continue running with the condenser restricted.

cases.title: HP safety open + condenser fan stopped

setup.ui_instruction: HP safety open + condenser fan stopped

expected.headline: Condenser fan failure is the first corrective target
expected.what_this_means: Loss of condenser airflow can directly cause the high-pressure trip.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot/restore condenser fan operation, then verify condensing pressure is safe before reset.
troubleshooting_path: Verify high-side pressure and safe reset.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge before restoring fan operation.

expected.headline: LP control may be performing normal pump-down control
expected.what_this_means: In a pump-down system, the solenoid closes and the compressor pumps suction down until the LP control opens; this can be normal sequence behavior.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm the system is intentionally in pump-down and verify the solenoid is closed/no longer feeding before treating the open LP control as a fault.
troubleshooting_path: Verify restart sequence on next cooling call.
must_not_conclude: Do not call the LP control defective solely because it is open at the end of pump-down.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded open but no flow

setup.ui_instruction: Solenoid commanded open but no flow

expected.headline: Liquid-line solenoid/flow path is blocking feed
expected.what_this_means: The evaporator can starve even though the control command is correct; separate coil/voltage from mechanical valve/restriction.
expected.next_action_check: Check coil voltage; correct voltage with no flow points to coil/valve/mechanical restriction, while no voltage points to control/wiring.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge before restoring commanded liquid flow.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded closed but flow continues

setup.ui_instruction: Solenoid commanded closed but flow continues

expected.headline: Liquid-line solenoid is leaking/stuck open
expected.what_this_means: A leaking/stuck solenoid can prevent pump-down and allow off-cycle refrigerant migration.
expected.next_action_check: Verify coil is de-energized; if it is and flow continues, service/replace the leaking/stuck valve.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust LP control to compensate for a valve that does not close.

expected.headline: Control sensor/input problem should be resolved first
expected.what_this_means: Bad sensor information can make otherwise healthy refrigeration cycle incorrectly.
expected.next_action_check: Validate sensor resistance/temperature or controller input against manufacturer data and a trusted reference; correct sensor/wiring before refrigeration adjustments.
must_not_conclude: Do not alter charge or TXV setting to compensate for a bad control sensor.

cases.title: Compressor running continuously + warm product load

setup.ui_instruction: Compressor running continuously + warm product load

expected.headline: Heavy pull-down load may explain long runtime
confirmed_findings: Large warm product load is present.
expected.what_this_means: Continuous operation can be expected during heavy pull-down if room/product temperature is steadily decreasing and equipment remains within operating limits.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm pull-down progress, airflow and operating limits; investigate refrigeration capacity only if temperature stops improving or limits are exceeded.
must_not_conclude: Do not call continuous runtime a compressor fault during a legitimate heavy pull-down.

cases.title: Compressor running continuously + no abnormal load

setup.ui_instruction: Compressor running continuously + no abnormal load

expected.headline: Cooling capacity problem requires systematic checks
expected.what_this_means: The system is operating but not removing enough heat; airflow, refrigerant feed, compressor performance, controls and sizing must be separated.
expected.next_action_check: Check room/load and evaporator airflow first, then condenser airflow, refrigerant feed/TXV behavior and compressor capacity.
must_not_conclude: Do not jump directly to refrigerant charge.

expected.headline: Evaporator fan is not running
expected.what_this_means: The direct airflow fault can contribute to icing and should be corrected before refrigerant diagnosis.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot/restore the evaporator fan first; then clear ice and verify normal airflow/defrost before rechecking refrigeration readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from an iced coil with a stopped fan.

cases.title: Iced coil + fan normal + defrost incomplete

setup.ui_instruction: Iced coil + fan normal + defrost incomplete

expected.headline: Defrost problem is indicated
confirmed_findings: Evaporator fan/airflow is normal during cooling.
expected.what_this_means: With cooling airflow normal and defrost incomplete, the defrost system becomes the primary path to investigate.
expected.next_action_check: Check defrost initiation, heaters/hot-gas operation, termination sensor/control and drain/drain-heater operation as applicable.
troubleshooting_path: Check heat source/current or hot-gas function.
Check drain; clear ice and verify full defrost.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust charge before correcting a confirmed defrost failure.

expected.headline: Air infiltration is a strong contributor to evaporator icing
expected.what_this_means: Warm humid infiltration adds moisture load that can rapidly frost/ice the evaporator.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the infiltration path, clear the coil, then verify defrost and normal cooling.
must_not_conclude: Do not treat refrigerant charge as the first cause while infiltration is confirmed.

expected.headline: Drain/drain-heater problem may be contributing to ice
expected.what_this_means: Water that cannot drain after defrost can refreeze and contribute to recurring ice accumulation.
expected.next_action_check: Check drain line slope/blockage, drain pan and drain heater operation; correct drainage and then verify defrost completion.
must_not_conclude: Do not assume all recurring ice is refrigerant-side.

expected.headline: Evaporator heat transfer is restricted
expected.what_this_means: A dirty evaporator reduces airflow/heat transfer and can mimic refrigerant problems.
expected.next_action_check: Clean the evaporator and verify fan/airflow; then stabilize and reassess box temperature and refrigeration readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting known evaporator heat-transfer restriction.

expected.headline: Condenser heat rejection is restricted
expected.what_this_means: Poor condenser heat rejection can reduce capacity and raise condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Clean condenser/restore airflow, then stabilize and reassess capacity and high-side readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose charge before correcting known condenser restriction.

expected.headline: Room load/infiltration should be corrected first
expected.what_this_means: Excess warm/moist air load can prevent the room from reaching setpoint even when refrigeration is functional.
expected.next_action_check: Correct infiltration and monitor pull-down before refrigeration adjustments.
troubleshooting_path: Investigate cycle only if still inadequate.
must_not_conclude: Do not add charge to compensate for building-envelope load.

cases.title: Poor cooling + high warm product load

setup.ui_instruction: Poor cooling + high warm product load

expected.headline: High load may explain slow pull-down
confirmed_findings: Large warm product load is present.
expected.what_this_means: A legitimate high product load increases pull-down time and compressor runtime.
expected.next_action_check: Verify temperature is trending downward and system remains within operating limits; investigate capacity only if pull-down stalls.
must_not_conclude: Do not call a fault solely from slow pull-down under known heavy load.

expected.headline: Do not apply steady-cooling refrigerant diagnosis during defrost
expected.what_this_means: Pressures/temperatures during defrost do not represent ordinary steady cooling and should not be used as normal charging/TXV evidence.
expected.next_action_check: Complete defrost, allow post-defrost recovery, then obtain stabilized cooling measurements before refrigerant diagnosis.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose charge/TXV from defrost readings.

expected.headline: Allow startup stabilization before diagnosis
confirmed_findings: Pressure readings are not yet stabilized.
expected.what_this_means: Transient startup pressures can differ substantially from steady cooling.
expected.next_action_check: Verify normal startup and allow readings to stabilize before applying pressure/SH/SC diagnostic patterns.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose charge from immediate startup readings.

expected.headline: Operating state explains why steady-cooling pressure rules do not apply
expected.what_this_means: Off-cycle/pump-down/satisfied pressures are not interpreted like active stable cooling.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm the control state and obtain readings during a normal cooling call if refrigeration diagnosis is needed.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose starvation from off-cycle suction pressure.

expected.headline: Allow post-defrost recovery before steady-state diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: Post-defrost load and refrigerant distribution are transient.
expected.next_action_check: Allow normal cooling recovery until temperatures/pressures stabilize, then evaluate SH/SC and pressures.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose charge/TXV from immediate post-defrost readings.

expected.headline: Evaporator fan is not running
expected.what_this_means: Two independent airflow faults are present. The evaporator fan is the immediate primary action, but the condenser restriction must remain active.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot/restore the evaporator fan first. Keep the dirty condenser as an active finding and correct it before final refrigeration measurements.
must_not_conclude: Do not drop/forget the dirty condenser after selecting the evaporator fan as primary.

expected.headline: Condenser airflow has multiple confirmed faults
expected.what_this_means: Both findings reduce condenser airflow/heat rejection and can coexist.
expected.next_action_check: Restore fan operation and clean the condenser; then verify airflow and recheck high-side conditions.
must_not_conclude: Do not choose charge diagnosis before both known airflow faults are corrected.

expected.headline: Evaporator fan fault must be corrected before interpreting high SH
expected.what_this_means: Abnormal airflow changes evaporator load and makes refrigerant-side interpretation unreliable.
expected.next_action_check: Restore evaporator airflow first, then stabilize and remeasure superheat before diagnosing charge/TXV.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge/TXV from high SH while fan is stopped.

cases.title: Dirty condenser + high head + high SC

setup.ui_instruction: Dirty condenser + high head + high SC

expected.headline: Correct condenser airflow before charge diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: The known heat-rejection fault can alter high-side pressure/subcooling; correct it before deciding overcharge.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/restore condenser airflow, stabilize, then reassess high head/high SC; only then evaluate charge/noncondensables.
must_not_conclude: Do not recover refrigerant before correcting the known condenser restriction.

cases.title: High SH + low SC + drier restriction evidence

setup.ui_instruction: High SH + low SC + drier restriction evidence

expected.headline: Localized filter-drier restriction outranks generic charge pattern
confirmed_findings: A significant temperature drop exists across the filter drier.
expected.what_this_means: Low SC can suggest low inventory, but localized drier evidence directly identifies a restriction that can starve the evaporator and create flash gas.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the filter-drier restriction first, then stabilize and reevaluate SH/SC/liquid condition before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not let the generic high-SH/low-SC pattern override localized restriction evidence.

cases.title: High SH + low SC + confirmed leak evidence

setup.ui_instruction: High SH + low SC + confirmed leak evidence

expected.headline: Low refrigerant inventory is strongly supported
expected.what_this_means: The starvation pattern plus independent leak evidence strongly supports refrigerant loss/low inventory, assuming airflow and operating state are valid.
expected.next_action_check: Locate and repair the leak, then evacuate/charge by approved procedure and verify SH/SC/pressures.
must_not_conclude: Do not simply top off refrigerant without addressing the leak.

cases.title: High head + fan stopped + suspected overcharge

setup.ui_instruction: High head + fan stopped + suspected overcharge

expected.headline: Condenser fan failure is the first priority
expected.what_this_means: The direct airflow fault can cause high head and must be corrected before charge is judged.
expected.next_action_check: Repair/restore condenser fan first; then stabilize and reassess head/subcooling/receiver condition.
must_not_conclude: Do not recover refrigerant before restoring condenser airflow.

cases.title: Sight-glass bubbles + low SC + drier ΔT

setup.ui_instruction: Sight-glass bubbles + low SC + drier ΔT

expected.headline: Liquid-line restriction is strongly indicated
confirmed_findings: Temperature/pressure drop is localized across the filter drier.
expected.what_this_means: The bubbles and low liquid margin are explained by a localized pressure drop at the drier; this evidence outranks bubbles as a generic low-charge clue.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the drier restriction, then stabilize and reassess liquid condition/subcooling before charge decisions.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting the localized restriction.

expected.headline: Two liquid-feed problems are active
expected.what_this_means: Both faults can affect evaporator feed. The localized restriction and known bulb fault should both be corrected before final TXV/charge judgment.
other_active_findings: TXV sensing-bulb problem remains active until corrected.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the filter-drier restriction and bulb installation, then stabilize and recheck superheat/liquid condition.
must_not_conclude: Do not assume one finding makes the other disappear.

expected.headline: Multiple heat-transfer faults are present
expected.what_this_means: Both sides have confirmed heat-transfer problems; refrigeration readings will not represent normal operation until they are corrected.
expected.next_action_check: Address evaporator icing cause/airflow and condenser cleanliness, then run stable cooling and collect fresh readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not perform charge diagnosis with both heat exchangers compromised.

cases.title: Compressor off + no cooling demand + dirty condenser

setup.ui_instruction: Compressor off + no cooling demand + dirty condenser

expected.headline: No compressor fault is established; condenser maintenance finding remains
expected.what_this_means: Compressor-off is expected without a call, while the dirty condenser is a separate maintenance/heat-rejection issue.
expected.next_action_check: Correct/clean the condenser as needed and verify compressor operation on the next legitimate cooling call.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose compressor failure because it is off with no demand.

cases.title: High SH + TXV bulb bad + equalizer issue

setup.ui_instruction: High SH + TXV bulb bad + equalizer issue

expected.headline: Multiple TXV input problems are present
expected.what_this_means: Both TXV sensing inputs can cause incorrect valve feed and must be corrected before charge or valve replacement decisions.
expected.next_action_check: Correct bulb installation and equalizer condition, then stabilize and recheck superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not add charge or replace TXV before correcting both known input faults.

cases.title: High head + dirty condenser + high ambient

setup.ui_instruction: High head + dirty condenser + high ambient

expected.headline: Known condenser restriction should be corrected; ambient remains context
expected.what_this_means: Both dirty coil and high ambient raise condensing conditions; the correctable restriction should be addressed first, then pressure judged against ambient.
other_active_findings: High ambient remains an operating condition.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/restore condenser airflow, then stabilize and compare condensing temperature/split to the high ambient condition.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge without correcting airflow and accounting for ambient.

expected.headline: Icing/airflow must be resolved before suction diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: Ice restricts airflow/load and can drive suction abnormal; refrigerant diagnosis is unreliable until the coil is clear and cause corrected.
expected.next_action_check: Diagnose/correct icing cause, clear coil, then stabilize and remeasure suction/SH.
must_not_conclude: Do not call low charge from low suction with a heavily iced evaporator.

expected.headline: Liquid-line solenoid fault explains starvation direction
expected.what_this_means: A closed solenoid can directly restrict liquid feed and cause low suction/starvation.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot solenoid command/voltage/valve operation first, then recheck suction and SH after flow is restored.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to correct starvation caused by a closed solenoid.

cases.title: High suction + low head + high room load

setup.ui_instruction: High suction + low head + high room load

expected.headline: Load context must be separated from compressor inefficiency
expected.what_this_means: High load can raise suction, while low head may reflect ambient/head-control conditions; compressor inefficiency is not proven.
expected.next_action_check: Check ambient/head-pressure control and compressor differential/current while tracking pull-down before condemning the compressor.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn compressor from high suction/low head without load and ambient context.

cases.title: Conflicting charge clues: high SH + low SC + high head

setup.ui_instruction: Conflicting charge clues: high SH + low SC + high head

expected.headline: Evidence is conflicting; do not force a charge diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: The pattern does not cleanly support one simple charge fault; airflow, ambient, restriction, measurement validity and possible multiple faults must be checked.
expected.next_action_check: Verify operating state and measurement validity, then check condenser airflow/ambient and localized liquid-line restriction before charge adjustment.
must_not_conclude: Do not force undercharge or overcharge diagnosis from conflicting evidence.

cases.title: Unknown operating state + direct physical fault

expected.headline: Evaporator fan is not running
expected.what_this_means: This is a direct evaporator-airflow fault. Unknown operating state does not prevent action on the observed fan fault; operating state still matters later for interpreting refrigeration measurements.
expected.next_action_check: Troubleshoot the evaporator fan first: check free rotation or obstruction, then command/voltage, capacitor if applicable, motor and controls. After restoring airflow, establish stable cooling before interpreting SH/SC/pressure patterns.
troubleshooting_path: Check fan/blade free rotation and obstruction.
Verify fan command and proper voltage.
If voltage is present, check capacitor if applicable and motor; if absent, trace control/wiring.
Restore airflow, establish stable cooling, then reassess refrigeration measurements.
must_not_conclude: Do not make “establish operating state” the primary headline when the evaporator fan is directly observed not running.
